pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that all seeded rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults the view to open, with WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id. 'AC-2' checks both / and ?view=open.
'AC-3' marks items 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'], so id order and the ✓ prefix are both checked.
'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' checks Open, closed, empty and __proto__ values. Each gets a 400 with no <li>. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views on an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. 'AC-8' asserts both are present. The traffic Worker fetches `https://app.internal${path}`, so a query string works.

findings.what: The AC-8 test only checks that routes.json contains the two strings. It does not check that the app answers 2xx for those routes, which CLAUDE.md requires of every listed path.
findings.fix: Add a loop that fetches each listed route against the app and expects status 200.

findings.what: The README names the new views but does not say that any other view value answers 400. The PR lists that as a behaviour change.
findings.fix: Add one clause to the README line about src/index.js saying an unknown view answers 400.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec and its decisions: it opens on open items, uses a query parameter, and adds no write route.

All eight AC items are implemented and named by a test. All six state-table rows have a test in the 'states' describe block. The spec was added in the same commit as the code, with the go dated 2026-10-12, and no later commit edits it.

I could not run `npm test` here because vitest is not installed (exit 127), so the tests are unrun. I read them and the assertions check behaviour. The existing test/index.test.js still holds under the new default view. No tests were deleted. The traffic fake app was extended to record the query string.
The README is updated. The unknown-view 400 is not mentioned (low finding).

The view value is checked against a whitelist with Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragments are constants. The empty-table check runs one extra COUNT query only when a non-all view is empty. The check script's route regex now allows ?, and still refuses spaces and #.
No injection path: the view parameter is whitelisted and titles are HTML-escaped. No instructions aimed at the reviewer were found in the repository.
The page is a minimal server-rendered nav and list. The diff touches no CSS or UI framework files.
No browser or screenshots exist in this session. Behaviour is covered by Worker-level tests.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims I checked against the diff are accurate: the 400 on other views, the empty messages, the traffic check change, and no tests loosened. The CI and Reviewer claims are not checkable from the repository.
